intro: A second party (GPT, OpenAI) wrote independent checkers that share no source with the producer and never executed the producer code. ``PASS'' means that the independent bound is at least as strong as the one used by the producer certificate. The table separates checks of saved certificate data from independent recomputation.

items.item: Upper bound $F_*^{\rm up}$ for the regular pentagon
items.method: conforming $P_2$ FEM Rayleigh quotient on an inscribed rational pentagon, exact integration with directed rounding: $F_*\le18.919118220170337$ (source and logs: \texttt{second\_party/p2\_fem}; the trial vector of the logged run is not archived, so the value is a historical log and a rerun certifies a fresh bound)

items.item: B\&B leaves form an exact dyadic partition of $[-1,1]^6$ (C--F); coverage only
Internal consistency of the 384 saved corner records ($\mu<1$, index inequality)
items.method: rational re-parsing of all saved balls; a check of saved data, not a recomputation

items.item: Min-corner geometry factor, certificates A and B (boxes 1, 3)
Corner eigenvalue lower bounds, certificates A and B (boxes 1, 3) (128 corners)
items.method: own interval Bessel series with tail bounds, third-order Taylor boundary bound, disk $L^2$ bound, FHM, Krahn--Szeg\H{o} index, on the exported coefficients; results in \texttt{second\_party/results/}; smallest margin over the producer bound 2.4e-05

items.item: Corner eigenvalue lower bounds, worst corner of each of C, D, E
Whole-leaf lower bounds of the T1 form (C--F)
items.method: not done: an independent second-order Taylor implementation reproduces the centre values and gradients of $Q_k$ (220 leaves of F, to $4\cdot10^{-15}$) but does not yet bound whole leaves

conclusion: Boxes 1 and 3 (certificates A and B) are fully replayed by the second party: geometry factors (exact fractions), all 128 corner eigenvalue lower bounds and the regular-pentagon upper bound (from a logged run whose trial vector is not archived). Certificates C--F are producer certificates whose whole-leaf bounds have not yet been replayed independently, and should be regarded accordingly.
abstract: for boxes 1 and 3 (certificates A and B) every load-bearing component -- geometry factors, all 128 corner eigenvalue bounds and the regular-pentagon bound -- has been recomputed by independent code.
